excerpts.text: Exercise A. Model rent using floor area as the only explanatory variable. Interpret the fitted slope in words.
Solution to Exercise A. The fitted slope describes the predicted change in rent for a change in floor area. This solution uses the dataset and model specified in Exercise A.
Exercise B. Model house sale price using floor area and number of bedrooms together. Explain how the partial slope for area should be interpreted.
